verses.eng: And the Lord was exceedingly angry with His people: and He abhorred His inheritance.

verses.lat: Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
verses.eng: And He delivered them into the hands of the nations: and they that hated them had dominion over them.

verses.lat: Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: sǽpe liberávit eos.
verses.eng: And their enemies afflicted them, and they were humbled under their hands: many times did He deliver them.

verses.lat: Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
verses.eng: But they provoked Him with their counsel: and they were brought low by their iniquities.

verses.lat: Et vidit cum tribularéntur: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
verses.eng: And He saw when they were in tribulation: and He heard their prayer.

verses.lat: Et memor fuit testaménti sui: et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.eng: And He was mindful of His covenant: and repented according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.lat: Et dedit eos in misericórdias in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
verses.eng: And He gave them unto mercies, in the sight of all those that had made them captives.

verses.lat: Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: et cóngrega nos de natiónibus: Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: et gloriémur in laude tua.
verses.eng: Save us, O Lord, our God: and gather us from among the nations: That we may give thanks to Thy holy name, and may glory in Thy praise.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord, for He is good: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
verses.eng: Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: and gathered out of the countries.

verses.lat: A solis ortu et occásu: ab aquilóne et mari.
verses.eng: From the rising and the setting of the sun, from the north and from the sea.

verses.lat: Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
verses.eng: They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: they found not the way of a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: Esuriéntes et sitiéntes: ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
verses.eng: They were hungry and thirsty: their soul fainted in them.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: And He led them into the right way: that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him: and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
verses.eng: For He hath satisfied the empty soul, and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.

verses.lat: Sedéntes in ténebris et umbra mortis: vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
verses.eng: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: bound in want and in iron.

verses.lat: Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
verses.eng: Because they had exasperated the words of God: and provoked the counsel of the Most High.

verses.lat: Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adjuváret.
verses.eng: And their heart was humbled with labours: they were weakened, and there was none to help them.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et edúxit eos de ténebris et umbra mortis: et víncula eórum dirúpit.
verses.eng: And He brought them out of darkness, and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him, and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: et vectes férreos confrégit.
verses.eng: Because He hath broken gates of brass, and burst iron bars.

verses.lat: Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: propter injustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
verses.eng: He took them out of the way of their iniquity: for they were brought low for their injustices.

verses.lat: Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
verses.eng: Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
verses.eng: He sent His word, and healed them: and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him: and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Et sacrifícent sacrifícium laudis: et annúntient ópera ejus in exsultatióne.
verses.eng: And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: and declare His works with joy.

verses.lat: Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
verses.eng: They that go down to the sea in ships, doing business in the great waters:

verses.lat: Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, et mirabília ejus in profúndo.
verses.eng: These have seen the works of the Lord, and His wonders in the deep.

verses.lat: Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: et exaltáti sunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: and the waves thereof were lifted up.

verses.lat: Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
verses.eng: They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: their soul pined away with evils.

verses.lat: Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
verses.eng: They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He brought them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et státuit procéllam ejus in auram: et siluérunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: And He turned the storm into a breeze: and its waves were still.

verses.lat: Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
verses.eng: And they rejoiced because they were still: and He brought them to the haven which they wished for.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him, and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
verses.eng: And let them exalt Him in the church of the people: and praise Him in the chair of the ancients.

verses.lat: Pósuit flúmina in desértum: et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
verses.eng: He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: and the sources of waters into dry ground.

verses.lat: Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
verses.eng: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.lat: Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
verses.eng: He hath turned a wilderness into pools of waters, and a dry land into water springs.

verses.lat: Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: And there He placed the hungry; and they made a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
verses.eng: And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: and they yielded fruit of birth.

verses.lat: Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: et juménta eórum non minorávit.
verses.eng: And He blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: and their cattle He diminished not.

verses.lat: Et pauci facti sunt: et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum et dolóre.
verses.eng: Then they were brought to be few: and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.

verses.lat: Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
verses.eng: Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: and He caused them to wander where there is no passing, and out of the way.

verses.lat: Et adjúvit páuperem de inópia: et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
verses.eng: And He helped the poor out of poverty: and made him families like a flock of sheep.

verses.lat: Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
verses.eng: The just shall see, and shall rejoice, and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.lat: Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? et intélleget misericórdias Dómini?
verses.eng: Who is wise, and will keep these things: and will understand the mercies of the Lord?

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy.

verses.lat: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, dele iniquitátem meam.
verses.eng: And according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my iniquity.

verses.lat: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: et a peccáto meo munda me.
verses.eng: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
verses.eng: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.

verses.lat: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
verses.eng: To Thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before Thee: that Thou mayst be justified in Thy words, and mayst overcome when Thou art judged.

verses.lat: Ecce enim in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
verses.eng: For behold I was conceived in iniquities; and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.lat: Ecce enim veritátem dilexísti: incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
verses.eng: For behold Thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of Thy wisdom Thou hast made manifest to me.

verses.lat: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
verses.eng: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

verses.lat: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
verses.eng: To my hearing Thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
verses.eng: Turn away Thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.lat: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
verses.eng: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

verses.lat: Ne projícias me a fácie tua: et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
verses.eng: Cast me not away from Thy face; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.

verses.lat: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: et spíritu principáli confírma me.
verses.eng: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation, and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

verses.lat: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: et ímpii ad te converténtur.
verses.eng: I will teach the unjust Thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to Thee.

verses.lat: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
verses.eng: Deliver me from blood, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol Thy justice.

verses.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

verses.lat: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: holocáustis non delectáberis.
verses.eng: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings Thou wilt not be delighted.

verses.lat: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: cor contrítum et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
verses.eng: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

verses.lat: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: Deal favourably, O Lord, in Thy good will with Sion; that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

verses.lat: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes et holocáusta: tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
verses.eng: Then shalt Thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon Thy altar.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Bonum est confitéri Dómino: et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.
verses.eng: It is good to give praise to the Lord: and to sing to Thy name, O Most High.

verses.lat: Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: et veritátem tuam per noctem.
verses.eng: To show forth Thy mercy in the morning, and Thy truth in the night.

verses.lat: In decachórdo, psaltério: cum cántico, in cíthara.
verses.eng: Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: with a canticle upon the harp.

verses.lat: Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.
verses.eng: For Thou hast given me, O Lord, a delight in Thy doings: and in the works of Thy hands I shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.
verses.eng: O Lord, how great are Thy works! Thy thoughts are exceeding deep.

verses.lat: Vir insípiens non cognóscet: et stultus non intélleget hæc.
verses.eng: The senseless man shall not know: nor will the fool understand these things.

verses.lat: Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: et apparúerint omnes qui operántur iniquitátem: Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi:
verses.eng: When the wicked shall spring up as grass: and all the workers of iniquity shall appear: That they may perish for ever and ever:

verses.lat: tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.
verses.eng: but Thou, O Lord, art Most High for evermore.

verses.lat: Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: et dispergéntur omnes qui operántur iniquitátem.
verses.eng: For behold Thy enemies, O Lord, for behold Thy enemies shall perish: and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.lat: Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.
verses.eng: But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: and my old age in plentiful mercy.

verses.lat: Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.
verses.eng: My eye also hath looked down upon my enemies: and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.

verses.lat: Justus ut palma florébit: sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.
verses.eng: The just shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus.

verses.lat: Plantáti in domo Dómini, in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.
verses.eng: They that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.lat: Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:
verses.eng: They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: and shall be well treated, that they may show:

verses.lat: Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: et non est iníquitas in eo.
verses.eng: That the Lord our God is righteous, and there is no iniquity in Him.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Audíte, cæli, quæ loquor: áudiat terra verba oris mei.
verses.eng: Hear, O ye heavens, the things I speak: let the earth give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.lat: Concrescat ut plúvia doctrína mea, fluat ut ros elóquium meum, quasi imber super herbam, et quasi stillæ super grámina.
verses.eng: Let my doctrine gather as the rain, let my speech distil as the dew, as a shower upon the herb, and as drops upon the grass.

verses.lat: Quia nomen Dómini invocábo: date magnificéntiam Deo nostro.
verses.eng: Because I will invoke the name of the Lord: give ye magnificence to our God.

verses.lat: Dei perfécta sunt ópera, et omnes viæ ejus judícia: Deus fidélis, et absque ulla iniquitáte, justus et rectus.
verses.eng: The works of God are perfect, and all His ways are judgments: God is faithful and without any iniquity, He is just and right.

verses.lat: Peccavérunt ei, et non fílii ejus in sórdibus: generátio prava atque pervérsa.
verses.eng: They have sinned against Him, and are none of His children in their filth: they are a wicked and perverse generation.

verses.lat: Hǽccine reddis Dómino, pópule stulte et insípiens? numquid non ipse est pater tuus, qui possédit te, et fecit, et creávit te?
verses.eng: Is this the return thou makest to the Lord, O foolish and senseless people? Is not He thy Father, that hath possessed thee, and made thee, and created thee?

verses.lat: Meménto diérum antiquórum, cógita generatiónes síngulas: intérroga patrem tuum, et annuntiábit tibi, majóres tuos, et dicent tibi.
verses.eng: Remember the days of old, think upon every generation: ask thy father, and he will declare to thee: thy elders, and they will tell thee.

verses.lat: Quando dividébat Altíssimus gentes, quando separábat fílios Adam, constítuit términos populórum juxta númerum filiórum Israël.
verses.eng: When the Most High divided the nations, when He separated the sons of Adam, He appointed the bounds of people according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.lat: Pars autem Dómini, pópulus ejus: Jacob funículus hereditátis ejus.
verses.eng: But the Lord's portion is His people: Jacob the lot of His inheritance.

verses.lat: Invénit eum in terra desérta, in loco horróris et vastæ solitúdinis: circúmduxit eum, et dócuit: et custodívit quasi pupíllam óculi sui.
verses.eng: He found him in a desert land, in a place of horror and of vast wilderness: He led him about, and taught him: and He kept him as the apple of His eye.

verses.lat: Sicut áquila próvocans ad volándum pullos suos, et super eos vólitans, expándit alas suas, et assúmpsit eum, atque portávit in húmeris suis.
verses.eng: As the eagle enticing her young to fly, and hovering over them, He spread His wings, and hath taken him and carried him on His shoulders.

verses.lat: Dóminus solus dux ejus fuit: et non erat cum eo deus aliénus.
verses.eng: The Lord alone was his leader: and there was no strange god with him.

verses.lat: Constítuit eum super excélsam terram: ut coméderet fructus agrórum, ut súgeret mel de petra, oleúmque de saxo duríssimo.
verses.eng: He set him upon high land: that he might eat the fruits of the fields, that he might suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the hardest stone.

verses.lat: Butýrum de arménto, et lac de óvibus, cum ádipe agnórum, et aríetum filiórum Basan: et hircos cum medúlla trítici, et sánguinem uvæ bíberet meracíssimum.
verses.eng: Butter of the herd, and milk of the sheep with the fat of lambs, and of rams of the breed of Basan: and goats with the marrow of wheat, and might drink the purest blood of the grape.

verses.lat: Incrassátus est diléctus, et recalcitrávit: incrassátus, impinguátus, dilatátus, derelíquit Deum factórem suum, et recéssit a Deo salutári suo.
verses.eng: The beloved grew fat, and kicked: he grew fat, and thick and gross: he forsook God who made him, and departed from God his Saviour.

verses.lat: Provocavérunt eum in diis aliénis, et in abominatiónibus ad iracúndiam concitavérunt.
verses.eng: They provoked Him with strange gods, and stirred Him up to anger with their abominations.

verses.lat: Immolavérunt dæmóniis, et non Deo, diis quos ignorábant: novi recentésque venérunt, quos non coluérunt patres eórum.
verses.eng: They sacrificed to devils and not to God, to gods whom they knew not: that were newly come up, whom their fathers worshipped not.

verses.lat: Deum qui te génuit dereliquísti, et oblítus es Dómini creatóris tui.
verses.eng: Thou hast forsaken the God that begot thee, and hast forgotten the Lord that created thee.

verses.lat: Vidit Dóminus, et ad iracúndiam concitátus est: quia provocavérunt eum fílii sui et fíliæ.
verses.eng: The Lord saw, and was moved to wrath, because His own sons and daughters provoked Him.

verses.lat: Et ait: Abscóndam fáciem meam ab eis, et considerábo novíssima eórum: generátio enim pervérsa est, et infidéles fílii.
verses.eng: And He said: I will hide My face from them, and will consider what their last end shall be: for it is a perverse generation, and unfaithful children.

verses.lat: Ipsi me provocavérunt in eo, qui non erat Deus, et irritavérunt in vanitátibus suis: et ego provocábo eos in eo, qui non est pópulus, et in gente stulta irritábo illos.
verses.eng: They have provoked Me with that which was no god, and have angered Me with their vanities: and I will provoke them with that which is no people, and will vex them with a foolish nation.

verses.lat: Ignis succénsus est in furóre meo, et ardébit usque ad inférni novíssima: devorábítque terram cum gérmine suo, et móntium fundaménta combúret.
verses.eng: A fire is kindled in My wrath, and shall burn even to the lowest hell: and shall devour the earth with her increase, and shall burn the foundations of the mountains.

verses.lat: Congregábo super eos mala, et sagíttas meas complébo in eis.
verses.eng: I will heap evils upon them, and will spend My arrows among them.

verses.lat: Consuméntur fame, et devorábunt eos aves morsu amaríssimo: dentes bestiárum immíttam in eos, cum furóre trahéntium super terram, atque serpéntium.
verses.eng: They shall be consumed with famine, and birds shall devour them with a most bitter bite: I will send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the fury of creatures that trail upon the ground, and of serpents.

verses.lat: Foris vastábit eos gládius, et intus pavor, júvenem simul ac vírginem, lacténtem cum hómine sene.
verses.eng: Without, the sword shall lay them waste, and terror within: the young man and the virgin together, the suckling with the man in years.

verses.lat: Dixi: Ubínam sunt? cessáre fáciam ex homínibus memóriam eórum.
verses.eng: I said: Where are they? I will make the memory of them to cease from among men.

verses.lat: Sed propter iram inimicórum dístuli: ne forte superbírent hostes eórum. Et dícerent: Manus nostra excélsa, et non Dóminus, fecit hæc ómnia.
verses.eng: But for the wrath of the enemies I have deferred it: lest perhaps their enemies might be proud, and should say: Our mighty hand, and not the Lord, hath done all these things.

verses.lat: Gens absque consílio est, et sine prudéntia. Utínam sáperent et intellégerent, ac novíssima providérent!
verses.eng: They are a nation without counsel, and without wisdom. O that they would be wise and would understand, and would provide for their last end.

verses.lat: Quómodo persequátur unus mille, et duo fugent decem míllia? nonne ídeo, quia Deus suus véndidit eos, et Dóminus conclúsit illos?
verses.eng: How should one pursue after a thousand, and two chase ten thousand? Was it not because their God had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?

verses.lat: Non enim est Deus noster ut dii eórum: et inimíci nostri sunt júdices.
verses.eng: For our God is not as their gods: our enemies themselves are judges.

verses.lat: De vínea Sodomórum, vínea eórum, et de suburbánis Gomórrhæ: uva eórum uva fellis, et botri amaríssimi.
verses.eng: Their vine is of the vineyard of Sodom, and of the suburbs of Gomorrha: their grapes are grapes of gall, and their clusters most bitter.

verses.lat: Fel dracónum vinum eórum: et venénum áspidum insanábile.
verses.eng: Their wine is the gall of dragons, and the venom of asps, which is incurable.

verses.lat: Nonne hæc cóndita sunt apud me, et signáta in thesáuris meis?
verses.eng: Are not these things stored up with Me, and sealed up in My treasures?

verses.lat: Mea est últio, et ego retríbuam in témpore, ut labátur pes eórum: juxta est dies perditiónis, et adésse festínant témpora.
verses.eng: Revenge is Mine, and I will repay them in due time, that their foot may slide: the day of destruction is at hand, and the time makes haste to come.

verses.lat: Judicábit Dóminus pópulum suum, et in servis suis misereábitur: vidébit quod infirmáta sit manus, et clausi quoque defecérunt, residuíque consúmpti sunt.
verses.eng: The Lord will judge His people, and will have mercy on His servants: He shall see that their hand is weakened, and that they who were shut up have also failed, and they that remained are consumed.

verses.lat: Et dicet: Ubi sunt dii eórum, in quibus habébant fidúciam?
verses.eng: And He shall say: Where are their gods, in whom they trusted?

verses.lat: De quorum víctimis comedébant ádipes, et bibébant vinum libáminum: surgant, et opituléntur vobis, et in necessitáte vos prótegant.
verses.eng: Of whose victims they ate the fat, and drank the wine of their drink offerings: let them arise and help you, and protect you in your distress.

verses.lat: Vidéte quod ego sim solus, et non sit álius Deus præter me: ego occídam, et ego vívere fáciam: percútiam, et ego sanábo, et non est qui de manu mea possit erúere.
verses.eng: See ye that I alone am, and there is no other God besides Me: I will kill and I will make to live: I will strike, and I will heal, and there is none that can deliver out of My hand.

verses.lat: Levábo ad cælum manum meam, et dicam: Vivo ego in ætérnum.
verses.eng: I will lift up My hand to heaven, and I will say: I live for ever.

verses.lat: Si acúero ut fulgur gládium meum, et arrípuerit judícium manus mea: reddam ultiónem hóstibus meis, et his qui odérunt me retríbuam.
verses.eng: If I shall whet My sword as the lightning, and My hand take hold on judgment: I will render vengeance to My enemies, and repay them that hate Me.

verses.lat: Inebriábo sagíttas meas sánguine, et gládius meus devorábit carnes, de cruóre occisórum, et de captivitáte, nudáti inimicórum cápitis.
verses.eng: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword shall devour flesh, of the blood of the slain and of the captivity, of the bare head of the enemies.

verses.lat: Laudáte, gentes, pópulum ejus, quia sánguinem servórum suórum ulciscétur: et vindíctam retríbuet in hostes eórum, et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
verses.eng: Praise His people, ye nations, for He will avenge the blood of His servants: and will render vengeance to their enemies, and He will be merciful to the land of His people.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, et dígitos meos ad bellum.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, and my fingers to war.

verses.lat: Misericórdia mea et refúgium meum: suscéptor meus et liberátor meus: Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.
verses.eng: My mercy and my refuge: my support and my deliverer: My protector, and I have hoped in Him: who subdueth my people under me.

verses.lat: Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?
verses.eng: Lord, what is man, that Thou art made known to him? or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him?

verses.lat: Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: dies ejus sicut umbra prætéreunt.
verses.eng: Man is like to vanity: his days pass away like a shadow.

verses.lat: Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: tange montes, et fumigábunt.
verses.eng: Lord, bow down Thy heavens and descend: touch the mountains and they shall smoke.

verses.lat: Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.
verses.eng: Send forth lightning, and Thou shalt scatter them: shoot out Thy arrows, and Thou shalt trouble them.

verses.lat: Emítte manum tuam de alto, éripe me, et líbera me de aquis multis: de manu filiórum alienórum.
verses.eng: Put forth Thy hand from on high, take me out, and deliver me from many waters: from the hand of strange children.

verses.lat: Quorum os locútum est vanitátem: et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis.
verses.eng: Whose mouth hath spoken vanity: and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Deus, cánticum novum cantábo tibi: in psaltério decachórdo psallam tibi.
verses.eng: To Thee, O God, I will sing a new canticle: on the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings I will sing praises to Thee.

verses.lat: Qui das salútem régibus: qui redemísti David, servum tuum, de gládio malígno: éripe me.
verses.eng: Who givest salvation to kings: who hast redeemed Thy servant David from the malicious sword: Deliver me.

verses.lat: Et érue me de manu filiórum alienórum, quorum os locútum est vanitátem: et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis:
verses.eng: And rescue me out of the hand of strange children, whose mouth hath spoken vanity: and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity:

verses.lat: Quorum fílii sicut novéllæ plantatiónes in juventúte sua. Fíliæ eórum compósitæ: circumornátæ ut similitúdo templi.
verses.eng: Whose sons are as new plants in their youth: Their daughters decked out, adorned round about after the similitude of a temple.

verses.lat: Promptuária eórum plena, eructántia ex hoc in illud. Oves eórum fœtósæ, abundántes in egréssibus suis: boves eórum crassæ.
verses.eng: Their storehouses full, flowing out of this into that. Their sheep fruitful in young, abounding in their goings forth: their oxen fat.

verses.lat: Non est ruína macériæ, neque tránsitus: neque clamor in platéis eórum.
verses.eng: There is no breach of wall, nor passage, nor crying out in their streets.

verses.lat: Beátum dixérunt pópulum, cui hæc sunt: beátus pópulus, cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
verses.eng: They have called the people happy that hath these things: but happy is that people whose God is the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exaltábo te, Deus meus, Rex: et benedícam nómini tuo in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: I will extol Thee, O God my King: and I will bless Thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Per síngulos dies benedícam tibi: et laudábo nomen tuum in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Every day I will bless Thee: and I will praise Thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Magnus Dóminus et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
verses.eng: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: and of His greatness there is no end.

verses.lat: Generátio et generátio laudábit ópera tua: et poténtiam tuam pronuntiábunt.
verses.eng: Generation and generation shall praise Thy works: and they shall declare Thy power.

verses.lat: Magnificéntiam glóriæ sanctitátis tuæ loquéntur: et mirabília tua narrábunt.
verses.eng: They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of Thy holiness: and shall tell Thy wondrous works.

verses.lat: Et virtútem terribílium tuórum dicent: et magnitúdinem tuam narrábunt.
verses.eng: And they shall speak of the might of Thy terrible acts: and shall declare Thy greatness.

verses.lat: Memóriam abundántiæ suavitátis tuæ eructábunt: et justítia tua exsultábunt.
verses.eng: They shall publish the memory of the abundance of Thy sweetness: and shall rejoice in Thy justice.

verses.lat: Miserátor et miséricors Dóminus: pátiens et multum miséricors.
verses.eng: The Lord is gracious and merciful: patient and plenteous in mercy.

verses.lat: Suávis Dóminus univérsis: et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord is sweet to all: and His tender mercies are over all His works.

verses.lat: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, ómnia ópera tua: et sancti tui benedícant tibi.
verses.eng: Let all Thy works, O Lord, praise Thee: and let Thy saints bless Thee.

verses.lat: Glóriam regni tui dicent: et poténtiam tuam loquéntur:
verses.eng: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom: and shall tell of Thy power:

verses.lat: Ut notam fáciant fíliis hóminum poténtiam tuam: et glóriam magnificéntiæ regni tui.
verses.eng: To make Thy might known to the sons of men: and the glory of the magnificence of Thy kingdom.

verses.lat: Regnum tuum regnum ómnium sæculórum: et dominátio tua in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
verses.eng: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: and Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Fidélis Dóminus in ómnibus verbis suis: et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
verses.eng: The Lord is faithful in all His words: and holy in all His works.

verses.lat: Allevat Dóminus omnes qui córruunt: et érigit omnes elísos.
verses.eng: The Lord lifteth up all that fall: and setteth up all that are cast down.

verses.lat: Óculi ómnium in te sperant, Dómine: et tu das escam illórum in témpore opportúno.
verses.eng: The eyes of all hope in Thee, O Lord: and Thou givest them meat in due season.

verses.lat: Áperis tu manum tuam: et imples omne ánimal benedictióne.
verses.eng: Thou openest Thy hand, and fillest with blessing every living creature.

verses.lat: Justus Dóminus in ómnibus viis suis: et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
verses.eng: The Lord is just in all His ways: and holy in all His works.

verses.lat: Prope est Dóminus ómnibus invocántibus eum: ómnibus invocántibus eum in veritáte.
verses.eng: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon Him: to all that call upon Him in truth.

verses.lat: Voluntátem timéntium se fáciet: et deprecatiónem eórum exáudiet, et salvos fáciet eos.
verses.eng: He will do the will of them that fear Him: and He will hear their prayer, and save them.

verses.lat: Custódit Dóminus omnes diligéntes se: et omnes peccatóres dispérdet.
verses.eng: The Lord keepeth all them that love Him: but all the wicked He will destroy.

verses.lat: Laudatiónem Dómini loquétur os meum: et benedícat omnis caro nómini sancto ejus in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless His holy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dixit insípiens in corde suo: Non est Deus.
verses.eng: The fool hath said in his heart: There is no God.

verses.lat: Corrúpti sunt, et abominábiles facti sunt in iniquitátibus; non est qui fáciat bonum.
verses.eng: They are corrupted, and become abominable in iniquities: there is none that doth good.

verses.lat: Deus de cælo prospéxit super fílios hóminum, ut vídeat si est intélligens, aut requírens Deum.
verses.eng: God looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, or did seek God.

verses.lat: Omnes declinavérunt, simul inútiles facti sunt; non est qui fáciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
verses.eng: All have gone aside, they are become unprofitable together: there is none that doth good, no, not one.

verses.lat: Nonne scient omnes qui operántur iniquitátem, qui dévorant plebem meam ut cibum panis?
verses.eng: Shall not all the workers of iniquity know, who eat up my people as they eat bread?

verses.lat: Deum non invocavérunt; illic trepidavérunt timóre, ubi non erat timor.
verses.eng: They have not called upon God: there have they trembled for fear, where there was no fear.

verses.lat: Quóniam Deus dissipávit ossa eórum qui homínibus placent; confúsi sunt, quóniam Deus sprévit eos.
verses.eng: For God hath scattered the bones of them that please men: they have been confounded, because God hath despised them.

verses.lat: Quis dabit ex Sion salutáre Israël? Cum convérterit Deus captivitátem plebis suæ, exsultábit Jacob, et lætábitur Israël.
verses.eng: Who shall give out of Sion the salvation of Israel? When God shall bring back the captivity of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam, et ne despéxeris deprecatiónem meam.
verses.eng: Hear, O God, my prayer, and despise not my supplication.

verses.lat: Inténde mihi et exáudi me. Contristátus sum in exercitatióne mea, et conturbátus sum
verses.eng: Attend to me and hear me. I am grieved in my exercise, and am troubled

verses.lat: a voce inimíci et a tribulatióne peccatóris. Quóniam declinavérunt in me iniquitátes, et in ira molésti erant mihi.
verses.eng: at the voice of the enemy and at the tribulation of the sinner. For they have cast iniquities upon me, and in wrath they were troublesome to me.

verses.lat: Cor meum conturbátum est in me, et formído mortis cécidit super me.
verses.eng: My heart is troubled within me: and the fear of death is fallen upon me.

verses.lat: Timor et tremor venérunt super me, et contexérunt me ténebræ.
verses.eng: Fear and trembling are come upon me: and darkness hath covered me.

verses.lat: Et dixi: Quis dabit mihi pennas sicut colúmbæ, et volábo et requiéscam?
verses.eng: And I said: Who will give me wings like a dove, and I will fly and be at rest?

verses.lat: Ecce elongávi fúgiens, et mansi in solitúdine.
verses.eng: Lo, I have gone far off flying away: and I abode in the wilderness.

verses.lat: Exspectábam eum qui salvum me fecit a pusillanimitate spíritus et tempestáte.
verses.eng: I waited for Him that hath saved me from pusillanimity of spirit and a storm.

verses.lat: Prǽcipita, Dómine, dívide linguas eórum, quóniam vidi iniquitátem et contradictiónem in civitáte.
verses.eng: Cast down, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen iniquity and contradiction in the city.

verses.lat: Die ac nocte circúmdabit eam super muros ejus iníquitas, et labor in médio ejus
verses.eng: Day and night shall iniquity surround it upon its walls: and in the midst thereof are labour

verses.lat: et injustítia. Et non defécit de platéis ejus usúra et dolus.
verses.eng: and injustice. And usury and deceit have not departed from its streets.

verses.lat: Quóniam si inimícus meus maledixísset mihi, sustinuíssem útique.
verses.eng: For if my enemy had reviled me, I would verily have borne with it.

verses.lat: Et si is qui óderat me, super me magna locútus fuísset, abscondíssem me fórsitan ab eo.
verses.eng: And if he that hated me had spoken great things against me, I would perhaps have hidden myself from him.

verses.lat: Tu vero homo unánimis, dux meus et notus meus,
verses.eng: But thou, a man of one mind, my guide, and my familiar,

verses.lat: qui simul mecum dulces capiébas cibos; in domo Dei ambulávimus cum consénsu.
verses.eng: who didst take sweetmeats together with me: in the house of God we walked with consent.

verses.lat: Véniat mors super illos, et descéndant in inférnum vivéntes, quóniam nequítiæ in habitáculis eórum, in médio eórum.
verses.eng: Let death come upon them, and let them go down alive into hell: for there is wickedness in their dwellings, in the midst of them.

verses.lat: Ego autem ad Deum clamávi, et Dóminus salvábit me.
verses.eng: But I have cried to God: and the Lord will save me.

verses.lat: Véspere et mane et merídie narrábo et annuntiábo, et exáudiet vocem meam.
verses.eng: Evening and morning and at noon I will speak and declare: and He shall hear my voice.

verses.lat: Rédimet in pace ánimam meam ab his qui appropínquant mihi, quóniam inter multos erant mecum.
verses.eng: He shall redeem my soul in peace from them that draw near to me: for among many they were with me.

verses.lat: Exáudiet Deus, et humiliábit illos, qui est ante sǽcula.
verses.eng: God shall hear, and the Eternal shall humble them.

verses.lat: Non enim est illis commutátio, et non timuérunt Deum.
verses.eng: For there is no change with them, and they have not feared God.

verses.lat: Exténdit manum suam in retribuéndo; contaminavérunt testaméntum ejus.
verses.eng: He hath stretched forth His hand to repay: they have defiled His covenant.

verses.lat: Divísi sunt ab ira vultus ejus, et appropinquávit cor illíus. Mollíti sunt sermónes ejus super óleum, et ipsi sunt jácula.
verses.eng: They are divided by the wrath of His countenance, and His heart hath drawn near. His words are smoother than oil, and the same are darts.

verses.lat: Jacta super Dóminum curam tuam, et ipse te enútriet; non dabit in ætérnum fluctuatiónem justo.
verses.eng: Cast thy care upon the Lord, and He shall sustain thee: He shall not suffer the just to waver for ever.

verses.lat: Tu vero, Deus, dedúces eos in púteum intéritus. Viri sánguinum et dolósi non dimidiábunt dies suos; ego autem sperábo in te, Dómine.
verses.eng: But Thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in Thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, quóniam conculcávit me homo; tota die impúgnans tribulávit me.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, for man hath trodden me under foot: all the day long he hath afflicted me fighting against me.

verses.lat: Conculcavérunt me inimíci mei tota die, quóniam multi bellántes advérsum me.
verses.eng: My enemies have trodden on me all the day long: for they are many that make war against me.

verses.lat: Ab altitúdine diéi timébo; ego vero in te sperábo.
verses.eng: From the height of the day I shall fear: but I will trust in Thee.

verses.lat: In Deo laudábo sermónes meos; in Deo sperávi, non timébo quid fáciat mihi caro.
verses.eng: In God I will praise my words: in God I have hoped, I will not fear what flesh can do against me.

verses.lat: Tota die verba mea exsecrabántur; advérsum me omnes cogitatiónes eórum in malum.
verses.eng: All the day long they detested my words: all their thoughts were against me unto evil.

verses.lat: Inhabitábunt et abscóndent; ipsi calcáneum meum observábunt.
verses.eng: They will dwell and hide themselves: they will watch my heel.

verses.lat: Sicut sustinuérunt ánimam meam, pro níhilo salvos fácies illos; in ira pópulos confrínges.
verses.eng: As they have waited for my soul, for nothing shalt Thou save them: in Thy anger Thou shalt break the people in pieces.

verses.lat: Deus, vitam meam annuntiávi tibi; posuísti lácrimas meas in conspéctu tuo.
verses.eng: O God, I have declared to Thee my life: Thou hast set my tears in Thy sight.

verses.lat: Sicut et in promissióne tua; tunc converténtur inimíci mei retrórsum.
verses.eng: As also in Thy promise: then shall my enemies be turned back.

verses.lat: In quacúmque die invocávero te, ecce cognóvi quóniam Deus meus es.
verses.eng: In what day soever I shall call upon Thee: behold, I know Thou art my God.

verses.lat: In Deo laudábo verbum, in Dómino laudábo sermónem; in Deo sperávi, non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
verses.eng: In God will I praise the word, in the Lord will I praise His speech: in God have I hoped, I will not fear what man can do to me.

verses.lat: In me sunt, Deus, vota tua, quæ reddam laudatiónes tibi.
verses.eng: In me, O God, are vows to Thee, which I will pay: praises to Thee.

verses.lat: Quóniam eripuísti ánimam meam de morte, et pedes meos de lapsu, ut pláceam coram Deo in lúmine vivéntium.
verses.eng: Because Thou hast delivered my soul from death, my feet from falling: that I may please in the sight of God, in the light of the living.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, miserére mei, quóniam in te confídit ánima mea.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me: for my soul trusteth in Thee.

verses.lat: Et in umbra alárum tuárum sperábo, donec tránseat iníquitas.
verses.eng: And in the shadow of Thy wings will I hope, until iniquity pass away.

verses.lat: Clamábo ad Deum altíssimum, Deum qui benefécit mihi.
verses.eng: I will cry to God the Most High, to God who hath done good to me.

verses.lat: Misit de cælo et liberávit me; dedit in oppróbrium conculcántes me.
verses.eng: He hath sent from heaven and delivered me; He hath made them a reproach that trod upon me.

verses.lat: Misit Deus misericórdiam suam et veritátem suam, et erípuit ánimam meam de médio catulórum leónum; dormívi conturbátus.
verses.eng: God hath sent His mercy and His truth, and He hath delivered my soul from the midst of the young lions; I slept troubled.

verses.lat: Fílii hóminum, dentes eórum arma et sagíttæ, et lingua eórum gládius acútus.
verses.eng: The sons of men, whose teeth are weapons and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.lat: Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, et in omnem terram glória tua.
verses.eng: Be Thou exalted above the heavens, O God, and Thy glory above all the earth.

verses.lat: Láqueum paravérunt pédibus meis, et incurvavérunt ánimam meam.
verses.eng: They prepared a snare for my feet, and they bowed down my soul.

verses.lat: Fodérunt ante fáciem meam fóveam, et incidérunt in eam.
verses.eng: They dug a pit before my face, and they are fallen into it.

verses.lat: Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum; cantábo et psalmum dicam.
verses.eng: My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: I will sing, and rehearse a psalm.

verses.lat: Exsúrge, glória mea; exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara; exsúrgam dilúculo.
verses.eng: Arise, O my glory; arise, psaltery and harp: I will arise early.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine, et psalmum dicam tibi in géntibus.
verses.eng: I will give praise to Thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing a psalm to Thee among the nations.

verses.lat: Quóniam magnificáta est usque ad cælos misericórdia tua, et usque ad nubes véritas tua.
verses.eng: For Thy mercy is magnified even to the heavens, and Thy truth unto the clouds.

verses.lat: Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram glória tua.
verses.eng: Be Thou exalted above the heavens, O God, and Thy glory above all the earth.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Si vere útique justítiam loquímini, recta judicáte, fílii hóminum.
verses.eng: If in very deed you speak justice, judge right things, ye sons of men.

verses.lat: Étenim in corde iniquitátes operámini; in terra injustítias manus vestræ concínnant.
verses.eng: For in your heart you work iniquity: your hands forge injustice in the earth.

verses.lat: Alienáti sunt peccatóres a vulva; erravérunt ab útero, locúti sunt falsa.
verses.eng: The wicked are alienated from the womb: they have gone astray from the womb, they have spoken false things.

verses.lat: Furor illis secúndum similitúdinem serpéntis, sicut áspidis surdæ et obturántis aures suas,
verses.eng: Their madness is according to the likeness of a serpent, like the deaf asp that stoppeth her ears,

verses.lat: quæ non exáudiet vocem incantántium, et venéfici incantántis sapiénter.
verses.eng: which will not hear the voice of the charmers, nor of the wizard that charmeth wisely.

verses.lat: Deus cónteret dentes eórum in ore ipsórum; molas leónum confrínget Dóminus.
verses.eng: God shall break in pieces their teeth in their mouth: the Lord shall break the grinders of the lions.

verses.lat: Ad níhilum devénient tamquam aqua decúrrens; inténdit arcum suum donec infirméntur.
verses.eng: They shall come to nothing, like water running down: He hath bent His bow till they be weakened.

verses.lat: Sicut cera quæ fluit auferéntur; supercécidit ignis, et non vidérunt solem.
verses.eng: Like wax that melteth, they shall be taken away: fire hath fallen on them, and they shall not see the sun.

verses.lat: Priúsquam intellígerent spinæ vestræ rhamnum, sicut vivéntes, sic in ira absórbet eos.
verses.eng: Before your thorns could know the brier, He swalloweth them up, as living, so in His wrath.

verses.lat: Lætábitur justus cum víderit vindíctam; manus suas lavábit in sánguine peccatóris.
verses.eng: The just shall rejoice when he shall see the revenge: he shall wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.

verses.lat: Et dicet homo: Si útique est fructus justo, útique est Deus júdicans eos in terra.
verses.eng: And man shall say: If indeed there be fruit to the just, there is indeed a God that judgeth them on the earth.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus, et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
verses.eng: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God: and defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.lat: Éripe me de operántibus iniquitátem, et de viris sánguinum salva me.
verses.eng: Deliver me from them that work iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.lat: Quia ecce cepérunt ánimam meam; irruérunt in me fortes.
verses.eng: For behold they have caught my soul: the mighty have rushed in upon me.

verses.lat: Neque iníquitas mea, neque peccátum meum, Dómine; sine iniquitáte cucúrri et diréxi.
verses.eng: Neither is it my iniquity, nor my sin, O Lord: without iniquity have I run and directed my steps.

verses.lat: Exsúrge in occúrsum meum et vide; et tu, Dómine Deus virtútum, Deus Israël.
verses.eng: Rise up Thou to meet me, and behold: even Thou, O Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel.

verses.lat: Inténde ad visitándas omnes gentes; non miseréaris ómnibus qui operántur iniquitátem.
verses.eng: Attend to visit all the nations: have no mercy on all them that work iniquity.

verses.lat: Converténtur ad vésperam, et famem patiéntur ut canes, et circuíbunt civitátem.
verses.eng: They shall return at evening, and shall suffer hunger like dogs: and shall go round about the city.

verses.lat: Ecce loquéntur in ore suo, et gládius in lábiis eórum, quóniam quis audívit?
verses.eng: Behold they shall speak with their mouth, and a sword is in their lips: for who, say they, hath heard us?

verses.lat: Et tu, Dómine, deridébis eos; ad níhilum dedúces omnes gentes.
verses.eng: But Thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them: Thou shalt bring all the nations to nothing.

verses.lat: Fortitúdinem meam ad te custódiam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es.
verses.eng: I will keep my strength to Thee: for Thou art my protector.

verses.lat: Deus meus, misericórdia ejus prævéniet me.
verses.eng: My God, His mercy shall prevent me.

verses.lat: Deus osténdet mihi super inimícos meos: ne occídas eos, nequándo obliviscántur pópuli mei.
verses.eng: God shall let me see over my enemies: slay them not, lest at any time my people forget.

verses.lat: Dispérge illos in virtúte tua, et depóne eos, protéctor meus, Dómine.
verses.eng: Scatter them by Thy power, and bring them down, O Lord, my protector.

verses.lat: Delíctum oris eórum, sermónem labiórum ipsórum; et comprehendántur in supérbia sua.
verses.eng: For the sin of their mouth and the word of their lips: and let them be taken in their pride.

verses.lat: Et de exsecratióne et mendácio annuntiabúntur in consummatióne; in ira consummatiónis, et non erunt.
verses.eng: And for their cursing and lying they shall be talked of, when they are consumed: when they are consumed by Thy wrath, and they shall be no more.

verses.lat: Et scient quia Deus dominábitur Jacob et fínium terræ.
verses.eng: And they shall know that God will rule Jacob, and all the ends of the earth.

verses.lat: Converténtur ad vésperam, et famem patiéntur ut canes, et circuíbunt civitátem.
verses.eng: They shall return at evening and shall suffer hunger like dogs: and shall go round about the city.

verses.lat: Ipsi dispergéntur ad manducándum; si vero non fúerint saturáti, et murmurábunt.
verses.eng: They shall be scattered abroad to eat: and shall murmur if they be not filled.

verses.lat: Ego autem cantábo fortitúdinem tuam, et exsultábo mane misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: But I will sing Thy strength: and will extol Thy mercy in the morning.

verses.lat: Quia factus es suscéptor meus et refúgium meum in die tribulatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: For Thou art become my support and my refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.lat: Adjútor meus, tibi psallam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es, Deus meus, misericórdia mea.
verses.eng: Unto Thee, O my helper, will I sing: for Thou art God my defence, my God, my mercy.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Deus, repulísti nos et destruxísti nos; irátus es, et misértus es nobis.
verses.eng: O God, Thou hast cast us off, and hast destroyed us: Thou hast been angry, and hast had mercy on us.

verses.lat: Commovísti terram et conturbásti eam; sana contritiónes ejus, quia commóta est.
verses.eng: Thou hast moved the earth, and hast troubled it: heal Thou the breaches thereof, for it has been moved.

verses.lat: Ostendísti pópulo tuo dura; potásti nos vino compunctiónis.
verses.eng: Thou hast shown Thy people hard things: Thou hast made us drink the wine of sorrow.

verses.lat: Dedísti metuéntibus te significatiónem, ut fúgiant a fácie arcus.
verses.eng: Thou hast given a warning to them that fear Thee: that they may flee from before the bow.

verses.lat: Ut liberéntur dilécti tui, salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me.
verses.eng: That Thy beloved may be delivered: save me with Thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.lat: Deus locútus est in sancto suo: Lætábor, et partíbor Síchimam, et convállem tabernaculórum metiébor.
verses.eng: God hath spoken in His holy place: I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem, and will mete out the vale of tabernacles.

verses.lat: Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses, et Éphraim fortitúdo cápitis mei.
verses.eng: Galaad is mine, and Manasses is mine: and Ephraim is the strength of my head.

verses.lat: Juda rex meus; Moab olla spei meæ.
verses.eng: Juda is my king; Moab is the pot of my hope.

verses.lat: In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum; mihi alienígenæ súbditi sunt.
verses.eng: Into Edom will I stretch out my shoe: to me the foreigners are made subject.

verses.lat: Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? Quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?
verses.eng: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?

verses.lat: Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos, et non egrediéris, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?
verses.eng: Wilt not Thou, O God, who hast cast us off? And wilt not Thou, O God, go out with our armies?

verses.lat: Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne, quia vana salus hóminis.
verses.eng: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the salvation of man.

verses.lat: In Deo faciémus virtútem, et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet tribulántes nos.
verses.eng: Through God we shall do mightily: and He shall bring to nothing them that afflict us.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exáudi, Deus, deprecatiónem meam; inténde oratióni meæ.
verses.eng: Hear, O God, my supplication: be attentive to my prayer.

verses.lat: A fínibus terræ ad te clamávi, dum anxiarétur cor meum; in petra exaltásti me.
verses.eng: To Thee have I cried from the ends of the earth: when my heart was in anguish, Thou hast exalted me on a rock.

verses.lat: Deduxísti me, quia factus es spes mea, turris fortitúdinis a fácie inimíci.
verses.eng: Thou hast conducted me, for Thou hast been my hope: a tower of strength against the face of the enemy.

verses.lat: Inhabitábo in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula; prótegar in velaménto alárum tuárum.
verses.eng: In Thy tabernacle I shall dwell for ever: I shall be protected under the covert of Thy wings.

verses.lat: Quóniam tu, Deus meus, exaudísti oratiónem meam; dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum.
verses.eng: For Thou, my God, hast heard my prayer: Thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear Thy name.

verses.lat: Dies super dies regis adjícies; annos ejus usque in diem generatiónis et generatiónis.
verses.eng: Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: his years even to the day of generation and generation.

verses.lat: Pérmanet in ætérnum in conspéctu Dei; misericórdiam et veritátem ejus quis requíret?
verses.eng: He abideth for ever in the sight of God: his mercy and truth who shall search?

verses.lat: Sic psalmum dicam nómini tuo in sǽculum sǽculi, ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.
verses.eng: So will I sing a psalm to Thy name for ever and ever: that I may pay my vows from day to day.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Nonne Deo subjécta erit ánima mea? Ab ipso enim salutáre meum.
verses.eng: Shall not my soul be subject to God? For from Him is my salvation.

verses.lat: Nam et ipse Deus meus et salutáris meus; suscéptor meus, non movébor ámplius.
verses.eng: For He is my God and my saviour: He is my protector, I shall be moved no more.

verses.lat: Quoúsque irrúitis in hóminem? Interfícitis univérsi vos, tamquam paríeti inclináto et macériæ depúlsæ.
verses.eng: How long do you rush in upon a man? You all kill, as if you were thrusting down a leaning wall and a tottering fence.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen prétium meum cogitavérunt repéllere; cucúrri in siti. Ore suo benedicébant, et corde suo maledicébant.
verses.eng: But they have thought to cast away my price: I ran in thirst. They blessed with their mouth, but cursed with their heart.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen Deo subjécta esto, ánima mea, quóniam ab ipso patiéntia mea.
verses.eng: But be thou, O my soul, subject to God: for from Him is my patience.

verses.lat: Quia ipse Deus meus et salvátor meus; adjútor meus, non emigrábo.
verses.eng: For He is my God and my saviour: my helper, I shall not be moved.

verses.lat: In Deo salutáre meum et glória mea; Deus auxílii mei, et spes mea in Deo est.
verses.eng: In God is my salvation and my glory: He is the God of my help, and my hope is in God.

verses.lat: Speráte in eo, omnis congregátio pópuli; effúndite coram illo corda vestra; Deus adjútor noster in ætérnum.
verses.eng: Trust in Him, all ye congregation of the people: pour out your hearts before Him. God is our helper for ever.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen vani fílii hóminum, mendáces fílii hóminum in statéris, ut decípiant ipsi de vanitáte in idípsum.
verses.eng: But vain are the sons of men, the sons of men are liars in the balances: that by vanity they may together deceive.

verses.lat: Nolíte speráre in iniquitáte, et rapínas nolíte concupíscere; divítiæ si áffluant, nolíte cor appónere.
verses.eng: Trust not in iniquity, and covet not robberies: if riches abound, set not your heart upon them.

verses.lat: Semel locútus est Deus, duo hæc audívi: quia potéstas Dei est, et tibi, Dómine, misericórdia; quia tu reddes unicuíque juxta ópera sua.
verses.eng: God hath spoken once, these two things have I heard: that power belongeth to God, and mercy to Thee, O Lord; for Thou wilt render to every man according to his works.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy.

verses.lat: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, dele iniquitátem meam.
verses.eng: And according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies, blot out my iniquity.

verses.lat: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea, et a peccáto meo munda me.
verses.eng: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco, et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
verses.eng: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.

verses.lat: Tibi soli peccávi et malum coram te feci; ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
verses.eng: To Thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before Thee: that Thou mayest be justified in Thy words, and mayest overcome when Thou art judged.

verses.lat: Ecce enim in iniquitátibus concéptus sum, et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
verses.eng: For behold, I was conceived in iniquities, and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.lat: Ecce enim veritátem dilexísti; incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
verses.eng: For behold, Thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of Thy wisdom Thou hast made manifest to me.

verses.lat: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor; lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
verses.eng: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

verses.lat: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam, et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
verses.eng: To my hearing Thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis, et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
verses.eng: Turn away Thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.lat: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus, et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
verses.eng: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

verses.lat: Ne projícias me a fácie tua, et Spíritum Sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
verses.eng: Cast me not away from Thy face: and take not Thy Holy Spirit from me.

verses.lat: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui, et spíritu principáli confírma me.
verses.eng: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation, and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

verses.lat: Docébo iníquos vias tuas, et ímpii ad te converténtur.
verses.eng: I will teach the unjust Thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to Thee.

verses.lat: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ, et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
verses.eng: Deliver me from blood, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol Thy justice.

verses.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries, et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

verses.lat: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique; holocáustis non delectáberis.
verses.eng: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings Thou wilt not be delighted.

verses.lat: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus; cor contrítum et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
verses.eng: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

verses.lat: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion, ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: Deal favourably, O Lord, in Thy good will with Sion: that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

verses.lat: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes et holocáusta; tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
verses.eng: Then shalt Thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations, and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon Thy altar.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, refúgium factus es nobis a generatióne in generatiónem.
verses.eng: Lord, Thou hast been our refuge from generation to generation.

verses.lat: Priúsquam montes fíerent, aut formarétur terra et orbis, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum tu es, Deus.
verses.eng: Before the mountains were made, or the earth and the world was formed: from eternity and to eternity Thou art God.

verses.lat: Ne avértas hóminem in humilitátem; et dixísti: Convertímini, fílii hóminum.
verses.eng: Turn not man away to be brought low: and Thou hast said: Be converted, O ye sons of men.

verses.lat: Quóniam mille anni ante óculos tuos tamquam dies hestérna quæ prætériit,
verses.eng: For a thousand years in Thy sight are as yesterday, which is past,

verses.lat: et custódia in nocte, quæ pro níhilo habéntur, eórum anni erunt.
verses.eng: and as a watch in the night, things that are counted nothing, shall their years be.

verses.lat: Mane sicut herba tránseat, mane flóreat et tránseat; véspere décidat, indúret et aréscat.
verses.eng: In the morning man shall grow up like grass: in the morning he shall flourish and pass away; in the evening he shall fall, grow dry, and wither.

verses.lat: Quia defécimus in ira tua, et in furóre tuo turbáti sumus.
verses.eng: For in Thy wrath we have fainted away: and are troubled in Thy indignation.

verses.lat: Posuísti iniquitátes nostras in conspéctu tuo, sǽculum nostrum in illuminatióne vultus tui.
verses.eng: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thy eyes: our life in the light of Thy countenance.

verses.lat: Quóniam omnes dies nostri defecérunt, et in ira tua defécimus.
verses.eng: For all our days are spent: and in Thy wrath we have fainted away.

verses.lat: Anni nostri sicut aránea meditabúntur; dies annórum nostrórum in ipsis septuagínta anni.
verses.eng: Our years shall be considered as a spider: the days of our years in them are threescore and ten years.

verses.lat: Si autem in potentátibus octogínta anni, et ámplius eórum labor et dolor.
verses.eng: But if in the strong they be fourscore years: and what is more of them is labour and sorrow.

verses.lat: Quóniam supervénit mansuetúdo, et corripiémur.
verses.eng: For mildness is come upon us: and we shall be corrected.

verses.lat: Quis novit potestátem iræ tuæ, et præ timóre tuo iram tuam dinumeráre?
verses.eng: Who knoweth the power of Thy anger: and for Thy fear can number Thy wrath?

verses.lat: Déxteram tuam sic notam fac, et erudítos corde in sapiéntia.
verses.eng: So make Thy right hand known: and men learned in heart, in wisdom.

verses.lat: Convértere, Dómine; úsquequo? Et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
verses.eng: Return, O Lord; how long? And be entreated in favour of Thy servants.

verses.lat: Repléti sumus mane misericórdia tua; et exsultávimus et delectáti sumus ómnibus diébus nostris.
verses.eng: We are filled in the morning with Thy mercy: and we have rejoiced, and are delighted all our days.

verses.lat: Lætáti sumus pro diébus quibus nos humiliásti, annis quibus vídimus mala.
verses.eng: We have rejoiced for the days in which Thou hast humbled us: for the years in which we have seen evils.

verses.lat: Réspice in servos tuos et in ópera tua, et dírige fílios eórum.
verses.eng: Look upon Thy servants and upon their works: and direct their children.

verses.lat: Et sit splendor Dómini Dei nostri super nos, et ópera mánuum nostrárum dírige super nos, et opus mánuum nostrárum dírige.
verses.eng: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and direct Thou the works of our hands over us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou direct.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Cantémus Dómino; glorióse enim magnificátus est, equum et ascensórem dejécit in mare.
verses.eng: Let us sing to the Lord: for He is gloriously magnified, the horse and the rider He hath thrown into the sea.

verses.lat: Fortitúdo mea et laus mea Dóminus, et factus est mihi in salútem.
verses.eng: The Lord is my strength and my praise, and He is become salvation to me.

verses.lat: Iste Deus meus, et glorificábo eum; Deus patris mei, et exaltábo eum.
verses.eng: He is my God, and I will glorify Him: the God of my father, and I will exalt Him.

verses.lat: Dóminus quasi vir pugnátor, Omnípotens nomen ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord is as a man of war: Almighty is His name.

verses.lat: Currus Pharaónis et exércitum ejus projécit in mare; elécti príncipes ejus submérsi sunt in Mari Rubro.
verses.eng: Pharao's chariots and his army He hath cast into the sea: his chosen captains are drowned in the Red Sea.

verses.lat: Abýssi operuérunt eos; descendérunt in profúndum quasi lapis.
verses.eng: The depths have covered them: they sank to the bottom like a stone.

verses.lat: Déxtera tua, Dómine, magnificáta est in fortitúdine; déxtera tua, Dómine, percússit inimícum.
verses.eng: Thy right hand, O Lord, is magnified in strength: Thy right hand, O Lord, hath slain the enemy.

verses.lat: Et in multitúdine glóriæ tuæ deposuísti adversários tuos; misísti iram tuam, quæ devorávit eos sicut stípulam.
verses.eng: And in the multitude of Thy glory Thou hast put down Thy adversaries: Thou hast sent Thy wrath, which hath devoured them like stubble.

verses.lat: Et in spíritu furóris tui congregátæ sunt aquæ; stetit unda fluens, congregátæ sunt abýssi in médio mari.
verses.eng: And with the blast of Thy anger the waters were gathered together: the flowing water stood, the depths were gathered together in the midst of the sea.

verses.lat: Dixit inimícus: Pérsequar et comprehéndam, divídam spólia, implébitur ánima mea; evaginábo gládium meum, interfíciet eos manus mea.
verses.eng: The enemy said: I will pursue and overtake, I will divide the spoils, my soul shall have its fill: I will draw my sword, my hand shall slay them.

verses.lat: Flavit spíritus tuus, et opéruit eos mare; submérsi sunt quasi plumbum in aquis veheméntibus.
verses.eng: Thy wind blew and the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

verses.lat: Quis símilis tui in fórtibus, Dómine? Quis símilis tui, magníficus in sanctitáte, terríbilis atque laudábilis, fáciens mirabília?
verses.eng: Who is like to Thee among the strong, O Lord? Who is like to Thee, glorious in holiness, terrible and praiseworthy, doing wonders?

verses.lat: Extendísti manum tuam, et devorávit eos terra.
verses.eng: Thou stretchedst forth Thy hand, and the earth swallowed them.

verses.lat: Dux fuísti in misericórdia tua pópulo quem redemísti; et portásti eum in fortitúdine tua, ad habitáculum sanctum tuum.
verses.eng: In Thy mercy Thou hast been a leader to the people which Thou hast redeemed: and in Thy strength Thou hast carried them to Thy holy habitation.

verses.lat: Ascendérunt pópuli et iráti sunt; dolóres obtinuérunt habitatóres Philísthiim.
verses.eng: Nations rose up and were angry: sorrows took hold on the inhabitants of Philisthiim.

verses.lat: Tunc conturbáti sunt príncipes Edom, robústos Moab obtínuit tremor; obriguérunt omnes habitatóres Chánaan.
verses.eng: Then were the princes of Edom troubled: trembling seized on the stout men of Moab: all the inhabitants of Chanaan became stiff.

verses.lat: Irruat super eos formído et pavor, in magnitúdine bráchii tui; fiant immóbiles quasi lapis, donec pertránseat pópulus tuus, Dómine, donec pertránseat pópulus tuus iste, quem possedísti.
verses.eng: Let fear and dread fall upon them, in the greatness of Thy arm: let them become unmoveable as a stone, until Thy people, O Lord, pass by: until this Thy people pass by, which Thou hast possessed.

verses.lat: Introdúces eos et plantábis in monte hereditátis tuæ, firmíssimo habitáculo tuo quod operátus es, Dómine; sanctuárium tuum, Dómine, quod firmavérunt manus tuæ.
verses.eng: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of Thy inheritance, in Thy most firm habitation which Thou hast made, O Lord; Thy sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established.

verses.lat: Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum et ultra.
verses.eng: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Ingréssus est enim eques Phárao cum cúrribus et equítibus ejus in mare, et redúxit super eos Dóminus aquas maris; fílii autem Israël ambulavérunt per siccum in médio ejus.
verses.eng: For Pharao went in on horseback with his chariots and horsemen into the sea: and the Lord brought back upon them the waters of the sea; but the children of Israel walked on dry ground in the midst thereof.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Meménto, Dómine, David, et omnis mansuetúdinis ejus.
verses.eng: O Lord, remember David, and all his meekness.

verses.lat: Sicut jurávit Dómino, votum vovit Deo Jacob:
verses.eng: How he swore to the Lord, he vowed a vow to the God of Jacob:

verses.lat: Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, si ascéndero in lectum strati mei,
verses.eng: If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house: if I shall go up into the bed wherein I lie:

verses.lat: si dédero somnum óculis meis, et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem,
verses.eng: if I shall give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

verses.lat: et réquiem tempóribus meis, donec invéniam locum Dómino, tabernáculum Deo Jacob.
verses.eng: or rest to my temples: until I find out a place for the Lord, a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

verses.lat: Ecce audívimus eam in Éphrata; invénimus eam in campis silvæ.
verses.eng: Behold, we have heard of it in Ephrata: we have found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.lat: Introíbimus in tabernáculum ejus; adorábimus in loco ubi stetérunt pedes ejus.
verses.eng: We will go into His tabernacle: we will adore in the place where His feet stood.

verses.lat: Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.
verses.eng: Arise, O Lord, into Thy resting place: Thou and the ark which Thou hast sanctified.

verses.lat: Sacerdótes tui induántur justítiam, et sancti tui exsúltent.
verses.eng: Let Thy priests be clothed with justice: and let Thy saints rejoice.

verses.lat: Propter David servum tuum, non avértas fáciem christi tui.
verses.eng: For Thy servant David's sake, turn not away the face of Thy anointed.

verses.lat: Jurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
verses.eng: The Lord hath sworn truth to David, and He will not make it void: Of the fruit of thy womb I will set upon thy throne.

verses.lat: Si custodíerint fílii tui testaméntum meum, et testimónia mea hæc quæ docébo eos:
verses.eng: If thy children will keep My covenant, and these My testimonies which I shall teach them:

verses.lat: et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum sedébunt super sedem tuam.
verses.eng: their children also for evermore shall sit upon thy throne.

verses.lat: Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion; elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.
verses.eng: For the Lord hath chosen Sion: He hath chosen it for His dwelling.

verses.lat: Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi; hic habitábo, quóniam elégi eam.
verses.eng: This is my rest for ever and ever: here will I dwell, for I have chosen it.

verses.lat: Víduam ejus benedícens benedícam; páuperes ejus saturábo pánibus.
verses.eng: Blessing I will bless her widow: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.lat: Sacerdótes ejus índuam salutári, et sancti ejus exsultatióne exsultábunt.
verses.eng: I will clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall rejoice with exceeding great joy.

verses.lat: Illuc prodúcam cornu David; parávi lucérnam christo meo.
verses.eng: There will I bring forth a horn to David: I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.
