verses.lat: Inimícos ejus índuam confusióne; super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.
verses.eng: His enemies I will clothe with confusion: but upon him shall My sanctification flourish.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ecce quam bonum et quam jucúndum habitáre fratres in unum!
verses.eng: Behold how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.lat: Sicut unguéntum in cápite, quod descéndit in barbam, barbam Aaron,
verses.eng: Like the precious ointment on the head, that ran down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron,

verses.lat: quod descéndit in oram vestiménti ejus; sicut ros Hermon, qui descéndit in montem Sion.
verses.eng: which ran down to the skirt of his garment: as the dew of Hermon, which descendeth upon Mount Sion.

verses.lat: Quóniam illic mandávit Dóminus benedictiónem, et vitam usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: For there the Lord hath commanded blessing, and life for evermore.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Laudáte nomen Dómini, laudáte, servi, Dóminum.
verses.eng: Praise the name of the Lord: O you His servants, praise the Lord.

verses.lat: Qui statis in domo Dómini, in átriis domus Dei nostri.
verses.eng: You that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.lat: Laudáte Dóminum, quia bonus Dóminus; psállite nómini ejus, quóniam suáve.
verses.eng: Praise ye the Lord, for the Lord is good: sing ye to His name, for it is sweet.

verses.lat: Quóniam Jacob elégit sibi Dóminus, Israël in possessiónem sibi.
verses.eng: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto Himself: Israel for His own possession.

verses.lat: Quia ego cognóvi quod magnus est Dóminus, et Deus noster præ ómnibus diis.
verses.eng: For I have known that the Lord is great, and our God is above all gods.

verses.lat: Ómnia quæcúmque vóluit Dóminus fecit, in cælo, in terra, in mari et in ómnibus abýssis.
verses.eng: Whatsoever the Lord pleased He hath done, in heaven, in earth, in the sea, and in all the deeps.

verses.lat: Edúcens nubes ab extrémo terræ, fúlgura in plúviam fecit.
verses.eng: He bringeth up clouds from the end of the earth: He hath made lightnings for the rain.

verses.lat: Qui prodúcit ventos de thesáuris suis; qui percússit primogénita Ægýpti, ab hómine usque ad pecus.
verses.eng: He bringeth forth winds out of His stores: He slew the firstborn of Egypt, from man even unto beast.

verses.lat: Et misit signa et prodígia in médio tui, Ægýpte, in Pharaónem et in omnes servos ejus.
verses.eng: He sent forth signs and wonders in the midst of thee, O Egypt: upon Pharao, and upon all his servants.

verses.lat: Qui percússit gentes multas, et occídit reges fortes:
verses.eng: He smote many nations, and slew mighty kings:

verses.lat: Sehon regem Amorrhæórum, et Og regem Basan, et ómnia regna Chánaan.
verses.eng: Sehon, king of the Amorrhites, and Og, king of Basan, and all the kingdoms of Chanaan.

verses.lat: Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem, hereditátem Israël pópulo suo.
verses.eng: And gave their land for an inheritance, for an inheritance to His people Israel.

verses.lat: Dómine, nomen tuum in ætérnum; Dómine, memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
verses.eng: Thy name, O Lord, is for ever: Thy memorial, O Lord, unto all generations.

verses.lat: Quia judicábit Dóminus pópulum suum, et in servis suis deprecábitur.
verses.eng: For the Lord will judge His people, and will be entreated in favour of His servants.

verses.lat: Simulácra géntium argéntum et aurum, ópera mánuum hóminum.
verses.eng: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, the works of men's hands.

verses.lat: Os habent et non loquéntur; óculos habent et non vidébunt.
verses.eng: They have a mouth, but they speak not: they have eyes, but they see not.

verses.lat: Aures habent et non áudient; neque enim est spíritus in ore ipsórum.
verses.eng: They have ears, but they hear not: neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.lat: Símiles illis fiant qui fáciunt ea, et omnes qui confídunt in eis.
verses.eng: Let them that make them be like to them: and every one that trusteth in them.

verses.lat: Domus Israël, benedícite Dómino; domus Aaron, benedícite Dómino.
verses.eng: O house of Israel, bless ye the Lord: O house of Aaron, bless ye the Lord.

verses.lat: Domus Levi, benedícite Dómino; qui timétis Dóminum, benedícite Dómino.
verses.eng: O house of Levi, bless ye the Lord: you that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus ex Sion, qui hábitat in Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord out of Sion, who dwelleth in Jerusalem.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Praise the Lord, for He is good: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Confitémini Deo deórum, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the God of gods: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino dominórum, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord of lords: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui facit mirabília magna solus, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who alone doth great wonders: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui fecit cælos in intelléctu, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who made the heavens in understanding: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui firmávit terram super aquas, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who established the earth above the waters: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui fecit luminária magna, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who made great lights: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Solem in potestátem diéi, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: The sun to rule the day: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Lunam et stellas in potestátem noctis, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: The moon and the stars to rule the night: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui percússit Ægýptum cum primogénitis eórum, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who smote Egypt with their firstborn: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui edúxit Israël de médio eórum, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who brought out Israel from among them: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: In manu poténti et bráchio excélso, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: With a mighty hand and with a stretched-out arm: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui divísit Mare Rubrum in divisiónes, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who divided the Red Sea into parts: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Et edúxit Israël per médium ejus, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: And brought out Israel through the midst thereof: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Et excússit Pharaónem et virtútem ejus in Mari Rubro, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: And overthrew Pharao and his host in the Red Sea: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui tradúxit pópulum suum per desértum, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who led His people through the desert: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui percússit reges magnos, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who smote great kings: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Et occídit reges fortes, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: And slew strong kings: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Sehon regem Amorrhæórum, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Sehon, king of the Amorrhites: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Et Og regem Basan, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: And Og, king of Basan: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: And He gave their land for an inheritance: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Hereditátem Israël servo suo, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: For an inheritance to His servant Israel: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: For He was mindful of us in our affliction: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Et redémit nos ab inimícis nostris, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: And He redeemed us from our enemies: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Qui dat escam omni carni, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Who giveth food to all flesh: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Confitémini Deo cæli, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the God of heaven: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino dominórum, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord of lords: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
